name: QuantityTakeoffEstimator
tagline: Measure, check, price and issue a construction estimate inside Power Apps and Power Pages.
description: A complete preconstruction estimating app in one PCF control: takeoff lines by trade and location with waste factors, material, labour-production, plant and subcontract rates, assembly templates, a measure-check-price-approve workflow with maker-checker, rate-outlier and double-count checks, and an estimate summary with preliminaries, overhead, contingency, profit, tax and cost per m².
features: Material, labour production, plant and subcontract rates
Copy assembly to location with quantity factor
Bulk waste %, rate escalation and status changes with undo
Estimate summary with mark-up cascade and cost per m²
